programme.title: 77 Heartwarmings
programme.desc: After breaking up with Adam, Eva focuses on her career, but Adam is determined to win her back and makes 77 attempts to do so. The situation worsens when a Thai movie idol courts Eva

programme.title: Tristar
programme.desc: A young priest striving to save lost souls crosses paths with a prostitute seeking refuge in the church to escape her debts, they get entangled in a CID investigation into a prostitution ring.

programme.title: Death Notice
programme.desc: The Police sets up a special task force to track down a serial killer who leaves death notices stating when, how and who he will murder. In the process, they expose an even bigger conspiracy behind.

programme.title: One More Chance
programme.desc: Chow Yun-Fat plays the unlucky gambler Chui Sui-Fai, whose ex-girlfriend asks him to take care of their autistic son. He reluctantly agreed and the two slowly begin to build their relationship.

programme.title: Cliff Walkers
programme.desc: Zhang Yi Mou's first spy thriller follows four Communist Party special agents who embark on a secret mission in the Japanese puppet state of Manchukuo - only to be sold out by a traitor.

programme.title: Table for Six
programme.desc: Three brothers reside in a home inherited from their late parents. The eldest brother insists on dinner together every night, but tensions rises when their girlfriends join the table.

programme.title: Tiger Wolf Rabbit
programme.desc: Three devastated parents unite after their children are abducted. Driven by grief and rage, they hunt down a brutal trafficking syndicate to bring their children home alive.

programme.title: The Last Dance
programme.desc: Debt-ridden wedding planner, Sheng, finds a lifeline as he transitions into a funeral planner. Inspired by the respected Master Wen, Sheng gradually changes his attitude towards his career and life.

programme.title: Lelio Popo
programme.desc: Famous radio DJs Jiang Man Da and Lu Ye Chang are fired and blacklisted. To make a comeback, they disguise themselves as elderly women to host a new radio show sparking unexpected success and comedy.

programme.title: High Forces
programme.desc: An A380 airliner is hijacked by gunmen on its maiden flight. Among the passengers is a security expert, whose daughter is one of the captives. Can he save all the passengers and avert the crisis?

programme.title: The Hedgehog
programme.desc: Wang's odd behavior and quirky ideas make him a social outcast. When he meets his teenage nephew who is ashamed of his stutter, the two develop a special friendship through mutual understanding.

programme.title: Kung Fu Hustle
programme.desc: This award-winning film directed, written and starred in by Stephen Chow, depicts the adventure of a wannabe gangster who aspires to join the notorious Axe Gang.

programme.title: Confinement
programme.desc: A pregnant painter hires a confinement nanny, but inexplicable incidents start happening in the house as her one-month confinement begins, threatening her and her baby daughter...

programme.title: An Abandoned Team
programme.desc: Uncle Jia is bad tempered and lives alone. He decides to end his life as he feels hopeless but is saved by a stray dog and an animal welfare volunteer, allowing him to rediscover his purpose in life.

programme.title: Ready o/r Knot
programme.desc: A couple who first meet at a wedding & have been together for five years, question the institution of marriage from opposing viewpoints. Should marriage always be the 'next step.'?

programme.title: Rob N Roll
programme.desc: A ruthless bandit plots a major heist which is joined by two dispirited men inadvertently. Their ad-hoc and dramatic robbery lands them in a fierce police pursuit, putting their lives on the line!

programme.title: Cloudy Mountain
programme.desc: As a decade-long tunnel project reaches completion, an earthquake strikes, forcing a retired soldier & his son to stop the disasters at the source, or risk the community - and the tunnel.

programme.title: Wish Comes True
programme.desc: Fei meets young talent Wai who suffers from a rare disease, and helps Wai find his lost love. Even when they know the drug treating Wai is ineffective, they choose to embrace hope and love together.

programme.title: Dust to Dust
programme.desc: A blurred figure in a news clip prompts retired cop Wang Shou Yue to reinvestigate a cold case where the mastermind gets tipped off and escapes. A battle between good and evil has just begun!

programme.title: We are Family
programme.desc: "Rent-a-Family" offers relatives for rent and in the process, the trio rendering such services discover the complexities of family relationships, forging deeper connections along the way.

programme.title: The Brotherhood of Rebel
programme.desc: Chai, a triad member, helps his friend Meow flee after Meow's attempt to kill his triad boss. 17 years later, their paths cross when Meow's life is in danger again. Will Chai choose loyalty over duty?

programme.title: Leap
programme.desc: At the 2008 Beijing Olympics, former volleyball legend Lang Ping coached Team USA to a controversial win over China. She later returned to rebuild China's team and won gold at Rio 2016.

programme.title: Table for Six 2
programme.desc: Bernard and Lung plan to get married when their eldest brother is away. Yet, the weddings spiral into a chaotic battleground with escalating family drama, creating a messy affair for all involved!

programme.title: Cyber Heist
programme.desc: After a security engineer unwittingly becomes involved in a money laundering operation, he must fight against his boss in the cyber world to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A traffic accident that resulted in a taxi driver being blinded inexplicably connects a group of unrelated people together, including blind masseurs from a massage center, a young man & a couple.

programme.title: YOLO
programme.desc: After years of self-neglect, Le Ying decides to embrace life anew. Meeting a boxing coach sparks her desire for a fresh start. Despite the challenges ahead, she embarks on a transformative journey.

programme.title: Hell Hole
programme.desc: The movie features three horror stories in different era, revolving around a pregnant woman, a bullied boy who committed suicide, and some company staff who open a box of used clothes.

programme.title: Little Red Sweet
programme.desc: A family running a Chinese dessert shop faces upheaval when the mother suffers a devastating stroke. This heartfelt journey reveals the strength of family bonds, sacrifices, and resilience.

programme.title: I Did it My Way
programme.desc: As the secretive dark world of online drug trafficking increasingly targets Hong Kong, the police launches a risky and secret operation to bring down one of the most notorious drug lords in Asia.

programme.title: Trouble Girl
programme.desc: Down with ADHD, Xiao Xiao faces school bullies and family issues. Her teacher Paul is her solace, but when she witnesses a secret between her mother and Paul, it adds complexity to her emotions.

programme.title: Honey Money Phony
programme.desc: Deceived by a romantic scam and burdened with a massive debt, Lin partners with con artist Ouyang to reclaim her money. Together, they defy the odds and discover an unexpected love in the process.

programme.title: Wolf Hiding
programme.desc: A cold-blooded killer vows to take revenge for her sister who was killed by a crime gang. Dealing with the police and the triad at the same time, a final battle between good and evil has just begun!

programme.title: Under Current
programme.desc: The death of a charity's CFO and a missing donation force lawyer Ma into an alliance with a police officer. Together, they risk everything to uncover the charity's darkest secrets and seek justice.

programme.title: Back To The Past
programme.desc: After helping Ying Zheng unite China, Hong Siu Lung lived in seclusion for 20 years until a time traveller returned to rewrite history, forcing them to defend the Qin dynasty and fate itself.

programme.title: My Blue Summer
programme.desc: Zhi has been secretly in love with high school classmate Nan from the moment they met. They finally become close friends when they entered the same university, but will Zhi ever confess his feelings?

programme.title: All's Well End's Well (Extended version)
programme.desc: In this Hong Kong comedy, three Chang brothers learn love needs care, not haste or selfishness. This extended cut adds a shootout scene missing from the 2016 Lunar New Year release

programme.title: Ride On
programme.desc: Master Luo, a retired stuntman, trains his beloved horse Red Hare to be a stunt horse. But due to his debts, he might lose his horse, so he seeks help from his estranged daughter & her boyfriend.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Set in 2020 during the outbreak of COVID-19, the movie features interconnected stories of three women's lives as they navigate the uncertain future amongst their respective friends and families.

programme.title: Back Home
programme.desc: Wing, who can see ghosts since young, discovers that the visions that once haunted him have become worse in his home. Caught between the living and dead, Wing must bring the truth to light to be free.

programme.title: Customs Frontline
programme.desc: The Hong Kong Customs officers uncover illegal weapons on a cargo ship linked to an international conflict. Elite agents go undercover and reveal a multinational operation with ties closer to home.

programme.title: Love for All Seasons
programme.desc: Womanizer Tiger Hung arrives in Mount Emei to get the cure of his illness. May is the only woman who is capable to do so, but Tiger has to break her heart first before she gains the healing power.

programme.title: Back To The Past
programme.desc: After helping Ying Zheng unite China, Hong Siu Lung lived in seclusion for 20 years until a time traveller returned to rewrite history, forcing them to defend the Qin dynasty and fate itself.

programme.title: Reunion Dinner
programme.desc: When an engaged couple is requested to invite their parents for a CNY client event, the fiance - who is estranged from his mother, fakes a family. However, things spiral out of control.

programme.title: L Storm
programme.desc: ICAC officer Luk and Inspector Lau are stuck in their investigation for bribery and money laundering cases. Framed for bribery, Luk risks everything to gather evidence to clear his name.

programme.title: Red Line
programme.desc: A former professional racer falls into despair after causing his brother's death. He meets Dr. Hui & becomes an ambulance driver. Meanwhile, his friends uncover the truth behind his brother's accident.

programme.title: OMG! Mom's Big News
programme.desc: A mother in her 50s unexpectedly becomes pregnant, turning her family's quiet life upside down. As they prepare for the baby's arrival, chaos and laughter follow, teaching them love and acceptance.

programme.title: The Shadow's Edge
programme.desc: A team of skilled thieves steals billions, outsmarting the 'Sky Eye' surveillance system. The Macau police enlist retired expert Wong Tak Chung to rebuild the elite squad and hunt down the mastermind.

programme.title: Out of Order
programme.desc: A successful lawyer's secret affair turns into a nightmare when a corpse unexpectedly turns up in the hotel room, triggering a desperate cover-up that spirals into uncontrollable chaos.

programme.title: Twilight of the Warriors: Walled In
programme.desc: Young Chan Lok Kwun accidentally stumbles into the dangerous Kowloon Walled City, subsequently finding purpose amid chaos and gaining wisdom while becoming one of the City's protectors.

programme.title: Stand Up Story
programme.desc: Mancer cares for his intellectually challenged father Wah. When Mancer finds solace in stand-up comedy, he turns his life's hardships into comedic gold, from school ridicule to pandemic woes.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: After being discovered flirting with his boss' daughter, Sing gets blown up, but later gets relived as his professor transforms him to be a cyborg of household products.

programme.title: The Sleep Curse
programme.desc: After two cult classic films from the 90s - director Herman Yau & Anthony Wong reunite, and together with Gordon Lam, Michelle Wai & Jojo Goh, challenge your limit in this paranormal thriller.

programme.title: The Ex-Files 4: Marriage Plan
programme.desc: Two brothers, Yun and Fei, face challenges in love. Yun dodges family pressure to marry after his breakup, and Fei and his girlfriend opt for a 'marriage cooling-off period' to tackle marriage issues.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: An imperial guard and his three traitorous friends ordered to hunt him down get accidentally buried and kept frozen in time. 400 years later, they are defrosted continuing the battle they left behind.

programme.title: 72 Tenants of Prosperity
programme.desc: Two sworn brothers become enemies after the girl they love marries one of them. The rivalry is only resolved when the property owner of their shops wants to terminate their tenancies 40 years later.

programme.title: Bursting Point
programme.desc: A failed drug raid leaves an undercover cop trapped and a drug lord vowing to seek revenge. Senior Police Inspector Li resorts to blackmailing a drug dealer with his daughter to arrest the drug lord.

programme.title: Love Lies
programme.desc: Gynaecologist Veronica falls for an online dating app scam with young Joe, who poses as a French engineer. What begins as a romance built on lies ultimately transforms two seemingly mismatched souls.

programme.title: Fox Hunt
programme.desc: Fraudster Dai resurfaces in Paris after seven years on the run. The Chinese Fox Hunt Team is on a cross-border mission to recover stolen assets and uncovers shocking secrets during the manhunt.

programme.title: The Way We Talk
programme.desc: Three deaf youths—Wolf, Sophie and Alan—develop a profound bond and support each other through sign language. United by love and friendship, they embark on a journey of self-discovery and resilience.

programme.title: Demi-Haunted
programme.desc: Starring Eason Chan, Joey Yung & Nicholas Tse, this dark comedy depicts the spirit of a Chinese opera singer who returns to perform a final song for her lover.

programme.title: Leap
programme.desc: At the 2008 Beijing Olympics, former volleyball legend Lang Ping coached Team USA to a controversial win over China. She later returned to rebuild China's team and won gold at Rio 2016.

programme.title: The Bride With White Hair
programme.desc: Based on the 1954 martial arts novel, this film details the tragic romance between wild swordsman Zhuo Yi-hang and rival cult assassin Lien Ni-chang, with a dark, erotic and visually stunning twist.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: In this screen adaptation of Louis Cha's famous novel, Stephen Chow plays small time punk Wei Xiao Bao alongside an all-star cast.

programme.title: The Sunny Side of the Street
programme.desc: A Pakistani refugee receive help from a taxi driver after his father died in a car crash. They gradually develop a father-son relationship, until Hassan discovers the truth behind his father's death.

programme.title: Golden Boy
programme.desc: Fallen boxing star "Golden Boy" Chang Li, after a decade in prison, must reconnect with the son he has never met. He rediscovers his purpose and returns to the ring to become the father his son deserves.

programme.title: Dead Talents Society
programme.desc: Newbie ghost Rookie must prove herself in the afterlife by delivering spectacular scares. A washed-up ghost diva and her agent help her battle to earn her haunting licence, or else she will vanish.

programme.title: P Storm
programme.desc: Ping reports a case of prison corruption to the ICAC. ICAC officer Luk goes undercover in prison to investigate and is determined to complete his mission with the help of his cell mate, Wang.

programme.title: Good Game
programme.desc: A desperate internet cafe owner recruits his daughter, a washed-up action star and a failed pro gamer to form a ragtag esports team—all for a HK$500k tournament and one last, no-regrets shot.

programme.title: All Suspects
programme.desc: A policeman on leave checks into a B&B with a detective novelist, a drifter and a pianist. When the owner and receptionist turn up dead, every guest becomes both suspect and sleuth...

programme.title: Guilt By Design
programme.desc: As a juror in a high-profile case learns that his daughter has been mysteriously kidnapped, he must decide whether to use his special skills to influence the trial as demanded by the kidnappers.

programme.title: Valley Of The Shadow Of Death
programme.desc: Years after his daughter's tragic death from assault, the offender resurfaces in church to ask for forgiveness. Torn between his faith and humanity, Pastor Leung faces a profound test.

programme.title: A Murder Erased
programme.desc: Police officer Choi is assigned to a case where the body was undiscovered for 8 years. During the investigation, the prosecutor finds all inconsistencies & suspicions fall on Choi.

programme.title: Back To The Past
programme.desc: After helping Ying Zheng unite China, Hong Siu Lung lived in seclusion for 20 years until a time traveller returned to rewrite history, forcing them to defend the Qin dynasty and fate itself.

programme.title: One and Only
programme.desc: A veteran and a passionate street dancer both strive to reach their goals and pursue their dreams in street dancing. After overcoming many challenges, can they finally shine on stage?

programme.title: Break Up Club
programme.desc: Jaycee Chan plays a 20-something slacker who discovers a magical website that may help reunite him and his girlfriend but at what cost?

programme.title: No One Like Me
programme.desc: Yang Qian Huan, once a golden boy, sees his glory fade after the birth of Xu Qi An. Yet, rising from his downfall, Yang defiantly forges his own path, refusing to bow to fate.

programme.title: The Movie Emperor
programme.desc: A Hong Kong megastar decides to make a film about rural China to win an award at a film festival. He experiences village life for a farmer's role, but this results in a series of hilarious events.

programme.title: True Love For Once In My Life
programme.desc: Sabrina's deep love for Andrew is shattered by his affair which ends their marriage. Years later, she returns to care for him as he is diagnosed with cancer, believing that true love comes only once.

programme.title: Schemes in Antiques
programme.desc: Despite his family's expertise in ancient Chinese relics, Xu Yuan resents their fraudulent ways. However, when fate shows him a route to redeeming their reputation, will he survive it?

programme.title: Cape No. 7
programme.desc: A Taiwanese singer tries to deliver seven old love letters attentioned to a Tomoko. As he falls in love with a young Japanese model also named Tomoko, he unravels their serendipitous connection.

programme.title: Marriage with a Liar
programme.desc: Kiki and Sean, who have been together for seven years, betray each other three days before their wedding. Faced with 'perfect' partners, they abandon their responsibilities and part ways.

programme.title: Relentless Fury
programme.desc: A mercenary team led by Captain Lin must protect a mysterious woman bearing the highest bounty in dark web history from global assassins, including an infamous fugitive in a deadly fight for survival.

programme.title: A Gilded Game
programme.desc: A finance intern's rapid rise under a top analyst ends when he betrays his mentor for a rival. To redeem himself and stop a hostile takeover, he must seek help from the man he wronged.
